spanish: Y si el santificante redimiere su casa, y añadirá quinto de plata de tu valoración sobre ella, y será a él.

findings.issue: The suffix is 3ms (him/it). "ella" is feminine, so it tracks casa, plata, or valoración and cannot be the masculine participant.

notes: Remaining tokens match: conditional 3ms redeems his house, adds a fifth of the silver of your (2ms) valuation, and it is to him.
